definitions.ask: How long should a launch-blocking git operation keep retrying SSH publickey denials?
definitions.why: 2026-11-04 clusters cleared within minutes; 6 tries at ~50% denial fail under 2% of launches

choices.label: ~110s over 6 attempts (5/10/20/30/45s); a wrong key fails a launch ~2 min late
~5 min over 9 attempts (up to 60s apart); rides out longer clusters, slower real failures
~30s over 4 attempts (5/10/15s); fails fast, but 7-denial clusters still kill launches

definitions.ask: Also classify `denied to deploy key` refusals as permanent authentication (sase-167's classifier half)?
definitions.why: same marker table; the precedence test needs a defined verdict for deploy-key text
